body: Barcelona really in their Tyler era FC Barcelona brought Tyler, the Creator’s GOLF WANG brand to El Clásico earlier today. The team swapped its usual Spotify sponsor logo for ‘GOLF’ against Real Madrid, marking the first time Barcelona gave an artist complete creative control over its collaboration. [via/ GettyImages, X FCBarcelona].
